description: WSO2 SAP SuccessFactors Candidate provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsRecruiting/overview). The service allows to query and maintain candidate profiles and their background information, such as education, work experience, certificates and languages.
key-features: Create, update and query candidate profiles
Maintain candidate background information, such as education and work experience
Manage candidate comments, tags and SMS notification preferences
